newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso still firm ahead of gov't debt auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso still firm ahead of gov't debt auction.

text.p: The Mexican peso remained firm late Tuesday morning, with more cash flowing into the local bourse and the central bank auction later in the day expected to bring higher primary interest rates, dealers said.
"The market is tracking the bourse and taking a keen interest in the primary auction," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart were 0.75 and 0.8 of a centavo firmer, respectively, at 7.8050/7.8075 and 7.8010/7.8040 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had closed trade for the day 2.4 centavos firmer at 7.7980/7.8010 per dollar.
